architecture: Bounded STARTING plus independent current-state admission and terminal event revocation
startup_policy: No HELLO, heartbeat or candle before aligned callback evidence followed by an independent healthy current-state poll. Contradictory startup transition stays blocked; it is not declared stale. Missing alignment times out.
revocation_policy: Observed current loss, event loss, unknown, unstable or mismatched source, registry uncertainty and lifecycle changes are terminal. After READY, non-Connected previous state is unproven continuity and terminal even if it resembles a startup duplicate.
reconnect_policy: Never restore the same session. New human-reviewed exporter and reader required. No execution readiness is granted.
current_source_policy: Exactly one registered futures source; stable configured provider and chart; both price and adapter channels Connected twice; no blocking registry lock.
market_closed_policy: Zero candles is valid. Heartbeats prove local liveness and current API-state checks, not tick delivery. Candle and HTF certification remain pending.

verification.environment: Process-local required API settings match the existing V17 api_settings fixture; no persistent configuration changes.
verification.native_compilation: PASS; installed Core/Gui/Custom and .NET/WPF reference assemblies; no provider loaded or native script installed
verification.whole_source_test: Actual exporter methods compiled with deterministic clock/timer and native host doubles. No account, order or provider-control API exists in the harness.
verification.canonical_reader_test: Actual synthetic native wire reaches unchanged reader: startup timeout cannot admit; heartbeat-only success creates no candles or runtime/execution instance.
